noUnboundedLoops.note: No untrusted-caller-reachable unbounded loop in a state-changing path. batchMigrate loops over a migrator-supplied (trusted, onlyMigrator) array, expected to be paged off-chain via getStakersRange. Views getStakers/getStakedTokens/getStakersRange return EnumerableSet arrays; getStakersRange offers explicit paging. EnumerableSet add/remove/contains are O(1).

checkedArithmetic.note: solc 0.8.28; zero `unchecked` blocks and zero inline assembly (grep-confirmed). All arithmetic is overflow/underflow-checked.

reentrancyUnguardedByDesign.reason: onlyOwner; makes external strategy.deposit call but owner is trusted (Law 3) and no user can reach it
onlyOwner; strict CEI with trailing safeTransfer, no post-transfer state

initializerProtected.note: Not upgradeable; single constructor sets immutable phUSD and Ownable owner. No initializer surface.

pausable.note: OZ Pausable + IPausable (Behodler3 pattern). whenNotPaused gates stake/withdraw/claim. emergencyWithdraw, userMigrate, batchMigrate, depositFor, initiateMigration, rescueERC20 are intentionally callable while paused.

totalStakedEqualsSumOfUserAmounts.note: All five totalStaked writes (stake +credited L252, withdraw -amount L271, emergencyWithdraw -user.amount L313, _exitPosition -amt L476, depositFor +credited L533) are matched by an equal user.amount delta. Hence totalStaked == Σ user.amount, which guarantees the subtractions never underflow.

localFindings.description: phusdPerSecond = amountPerDay / SECONDS_PER_DAY (floor). Any daily budget below 86400 wei of phUSD silently rounds to a 0 wei/sec emission rate, so the pool emits nothing while still appearing configured. Realistic budgets (>= ~1e5 wei, and any human-scale phUSD/day) are unaffected, so this requires an implausibly tiny budget to trigger.
localFindings.recommendation: Optionally require amountPerDay >= SECONDS_PER_DAY (or revert when the computed perSecond == 0 for a non-zero budget) to make a misconfigured rate fail loudly. Surfaced for recall; classifier may treat as informational/QA given the implausible config.

notFlaggedDeferredToInteraction: phUSD.mint reverting (e.g. authorized-minter revocation via mintVersion bump) would brick reward-minting paths (claim, and the _settle leg of stake/withdraw/depositFor). emergencyWithdraw and userMigrate forfeit/freeze reward minting differently and the escape hatch never mints, so principal is never trapped by a broken mint. Cross-contract dependency -> interaction analysis.

Yield-strategy underwater / slippage / AMM price-impact behaviour, and whether _routeExit's measured-received vs requested-decrement accounting leaks value, depend on the concrete IYieldStrategy implementation -> interaction/econ analysis.

setYieldStrategy replacing an in-use strategy without first draining it strands principal in the old (now de-allowanced) strategy. Documented in the source/CLAUDE.md as an owner operational hazard; cross-contract -> surfaced as trust assumption, not a local finding.

rescueERC20 treats reserved==0 when a strategy is set, so the on-contract idle buffer (used to satisfy underwater withdraws) is owner-rescuable. Whether this can strip the buffer is an economic/owner-trust concern across the strategy boundary -> interaction/econ analysis.

constants.name: ACC_PRECISION
constants.purpose: fixed-point scale for accPhusdPerShare; dust rounds down

sweeps idle balance into new strategy; does NOT migrate funds out of an old in-use strategy
reverts 'strategy underwater' when strategy below par and buffer insufficient

externalEntryPoints.accessControl: none (callable while paused; blocked while migrating)
externalEntryPoints.note: forfeits pending reward; never mints phUSD so a broken mint path cannot trap principal; accepts haircut if strategy below par. No poolExists modifier but user.amount>0 guard makes unregistered tokens unreachable.
terminal, runs once; reverts 'incomplete exit' if strategy.principalOf != 0 after exit

externalEntryPoints.function: batchMigrate(address token, address[] users) returns (uint256[] amounts)
externalEntryPoints.note: credit_i = p_i*min(R,P)/P from immutable snapshot; Sigma amounts <= R
permissionless terminal escape hatch; same credit as batch; CEI (zero before transfer)

externalEntryPoints.note: callable while paused; pulls from migrator. Blocked on the OLD migrating staker; redeposit target is the NEW staker.

externalEntryPoints.note: reserved = totalStaked when no strategy set (protects idle principal), else 0; require bal >= reserved + amount

externalEntryPoints.note: half-open [start,end), end clamped to length; paging helper for batchMigrate

externalCalls.notes: Phoenix FlaxToken; this contract must be an authorized minter. mint reverts if minter privilege revoked (mintVersion mismatch) -> would brick reward-minting legs but not emergencyWithdraw/userMigrate principal return. Cross-contract behaviour deferred to interaction analysis.

Phoenix reflax-yield-vault adapter, owner-wired; strategy owner must setClient(this,true). deposit may haircut credited principal (market strategy slippage); withdraw forwards measured-received. Reentrancy from strategy callbacks is contained by nonReentrant on all principal paths. Strategy correctness (principalOf/totalBalanceOf honesty, underwater behaviour) deferred to interaction analysis.

Assumed standard ERC20: no fee-on-transfer (known-issue exclusion; would make credited<requested and drift accounting), no rebasing, no transfer hooks. _pullToken/_routeExit use balance-delta measurement.
External actor that can pause; owner OR pauser can unpause. Pauser identity set by owner via setPauser.

localInvariants.statement: _updatePool is the SOLE writer of poolInfo[token].accPhusdPerShare; it folds in exactly elapsed*phusdPerSecond per update. No sequence of user actions can mint more than phUSDPerDay over any window.
localInvariants.evidence: grep: the only storage assignment to accPhusdPerShare is L623 inside _updatePool; every other occurrence is a read. Rate changes (phUSDPerDay) call _updatePool first, so changes are never retroactive.

localInvariants.statement: All reward and migration division is integer floor in the protocol's favor: acc += reward*ACC_PRECISION/totalStaked, pending = amount*acc/ACC_PRECISION - rewardDebt, credit = amt*min(R,P)/P. Realized emission <= phusdPerSecond*elapsed; Sigma migration credits <= min(R,P) <= R.
localInvariants.evidence: No unchecked/assembly (grep). Floor division at L550/L623 (rewards) and L468 (migration). Conservation Sigma floor(p_i*S/P) <= (S/P)*Sigma p_i = S documented and arithmetically sound.

localInvariants.statement: poolInfo[token].totalStaked == sum over users of userInfo[token][user].amount at all times, so the totalStaked-=amount subtractions can never underflow.
localInvariants.evidence: Every totalStaked write (L252,271,313,476,533) is paired with an equal user.amount delta; withdraw/_exitPosition guard amount<=user.amount; emergencyWithdraw/_exitPosition subtract exactly the zeroed amount.

localInvariants.statement: Once migrationInfo[token].active is true it is terminal (no clearing path) and _updatePool no-ops, freezing each user's pending phUSD at the initiateMigration snapshot; stake/withdraw/emergencyWithdraw/depositFor on that token are blocked so P is immutable.
localInvariants.evidence: _updatePool early-returns on active (L609); the four mutating paths require !migrationInfo[token].active; migrationInfo is only ever written in initiateMigration.

localInvariants.statement: Terminal-migration credit_i = amt_i*min(R,P)/P uses the immutable snapshot (R,P) and the fixed denominator P (not a re-summed batch total), so payouts are independent of batch composition, ordering, and batch-vs-self; equal principal => equal payout.
localInvariants.evidence: _exitPosition reads mig.principalSnapshot/mig.realized only; batchMigrate and userMigrate both route through _exitPosition. Closes legacy ss2m1/M-01.

localInvariants.statement: The idle pile realized at initiateMigration (R) covers every credit in any interleaving of batch/self exits; the last claimer is never starved. Floor dust stays protocol-owned.
localInvariants.evidence: Sigma floor(p_i*S/P) <= S <= R with S=min(R,P); credits paid only from idle balance, no strategy round-trip post-initiate.

localInvariants.statement: rescueERC20 cannot withdraw idle-held user principal: when yieldStrategy[token]==address(0), reserved=totalStaked and require(bal>=reserved+amount).
localInvariants.evidence: L708-710. NOTE (deferred): when a strategy IS set, reserved=0 and the on-contract buffer becomes fully rescuable; the buffer's role in underwater withdraws makes this an econ/owner-trust question, not a local violation.

localInvariants.statement: All token-transferring exits zero/decrement state before the external token transfer and carry nonReentrant: withdraw, emergencyWithdraw, batchMigrate, userMigrate, _exitPosition.
localInvariants.evidence: Effects precede safeTransfer in each; nonReentrant present (grep L238/259/304/431/495/518).

trustAssumptions: phUSD authorized-minter relationship is and stays valid (phUSD.setMinter(staker,true)); a revocation (mintVersion bump) bricks reward-minting legs but never traps principal (emergencyWithdraw/userMigrate return principal without minting).

Staked tokens are standard ERC20s: no fee-on-transfer (known-issue exclusion), no rebasing, no transfer/approve hooks. Fee-on-transfer would make credited<requested and drift the totalStaked accounting.

Each configured IYieldStrategy is honest and correctly wired (strategy owner has called setClient(staker,true)); principalOf/totalBalanceOf/deposit/withdraw behave per spec. Strategy correctness is out of local scope.

Owner is trusted and non-malicious (Law 3). Owner-only setters (addToken, phUSDPerDay, setMigrator, setPauser, setYieldStrategy, rescueERC20) are config surface. Operational footguns to flag to ops: (a) setYieldStrategy replacing an in-use strategy without first draining the old one strands principal in the de-allowanced old strategy; (b) phUSDPerDay below 86400 wei/day silently emits 0; (c) rescueERC20 can sweep the idle buffer used for underwater withdraws when a strategy is set.

migrator is a trusted permissioned role (the StableStakerMigrator). initiateMigration/batchMigrate/depositFor are fully under migrator control; batchMigrate batch size and composition are the migrator's responsibility (paged off-chain).
pauser is a trusted Behodler3/Global-Pauser address set by owner; it can halt stake/withdraw/claim but cannot block the escape hatches.
